description: Declare an ADLS storage container as an external asset in the Dagster asset graph — makes it visible for lineage without materializing it from Dagster.

create_observation_sensor.label: Create Observation Sensor
create_observation_sensor.description: Also create the polling sensor that keeps this external asset's health/data-version current (same logic as the standalone adls_observation_sensor component). When False (default), this component only declares the AssetSpec.

sensor_name.label: Sensor Name
sensor_name.description: Unique sensor name. Defaults to '{container_name}__observation_sensor'. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

check_interval_seconds.label: Check Interval Seconds
check_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between health checks. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Dagster resource key exposing `.observe(source) -> dict`. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True; unset uses azure-storage-file-datalake directly.

connection_string_env_var.label: Connection String Env Var
connection_string_env_var.description: Env var with connection string (alternative to DefaultAzureCredential). Only used when create_observation_sensor=True and resource_key is unset.

emit_materialization.label: Emit Materialization
emit_materialization.description: When True (default), the sensor emits AssetMaterialization. When False, emits AssetObservation instead. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: ISO start date for time-based partition types (e.g. '2024-01-01').

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static / multi partition types.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

name: External ADLS Asset
